translations.web: All the inhabitants of the islands are astonished at you, and their kings are horribly afraid. They are troubled in their face.
translations.bsb: All the people of the coastlands are appalled over you. Their kings shudder with fear; their faces are contorted.
translations.kjv: All the inhabitants of the isles shall be astonished at thee, and their kings shall be sore afraid, they shall be troubled in their countenance.
